==Description==
'''v2.12.0''' is the one hundred and fifty-sixth update to be released in Tower Defense Simulator, on the 25th of September 2026.

This update encompassed two versions, the main v2.12.0 update (released 25 September 2026) and the v2.12.1 (released 26 September 2026).

==Changes & Bugfixes==
===Towers===
*[[Executioner]] reworked.
**Bouncing mechanic changed from just being a simple limit on how many enemies it can bounce per throw, with no limit on how many enemies it can hit. It is now two limits, a bounce limit which also acts as the max limit of enemies it can hit per throw and a max targets, a limit of how many unique enemies it can damage per throw.
**No longer deals tick based damage.
**Changing targeting while the axe is in the air no longer does anything.
**Now boosts the damage it deals after a bounce, resetting back to base damage once the axe has returned.
**Now can bounce to an enemy it has already bounced to.
**Description changed.
**'''Executioner''' is now available through a gamepass for {{Robux|799}}.
**Statistical changes:
***'''Base'''
****Cost increased from {{Money|750}} to {{Money|1,800}}.
****Damage increased from 5 to 7.
****Firerate decreased from 3 to 1.
****Bounces increased from 3 to 5.
****Range increased from 14 to 15.
****6 added damage added.
****3 max targets added.
****1 windup added.
****0.1 catch time added.
****0.4 max flight time added.
****0.55 max return time added.
****0.15 tick removed.
****3  max hits removed.
***'''Level 1'''
****Cost increased from {{Money|250}} to {{Money|450}}.
****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|3 > 2|-1}} to {{Tooltip|1 > 0.75|-0.25}}.
****Range increased from +0 to +2.
****Name changed fro ''Improved Throwing'' to ''Quick Chopping''.
***'''Level 2'''
****Cost increased from {{Money|750}} to {{Money|1,777}}.
****Damage increased from +5 to +7.
****Max targets increase of +1 added.
****Bounces increased from +0 to +1.
****Name changed fro ''Double Head Axe'' to ''Double-Headed Axe''.
***'''Level 3'''
****Cost increased from {{Money|1,900}} to {{Money|3,750}}.
****Damage decreased from +8 to +6.
****Range decreased from +4 to +0.
****Added damage increase of +6 added.
****Hidden detection added, moved from Level 4.
****Name changed fro ''Blood Seeking'' to ''Cloaked Revenant''.
***'''Level 4'''
****Cost increased from {{Money|4,500}} to {{Money|6,750}}.
****Damage increased from +17 to +20.
****Max targets increase of +2 added.
****Bounces increased from +0 to +2.
****Added damage increase of +1 added.
****Hidden detection moved to Level 4.
****Name changed fro ''Tactical Ops'' to ''Ghoul Shreddin'''.
***'''Level 5'''
****Cost increased from {{Money|12,500}} to {{Money|13,500}}.
****Damage decreased from +45 to +10.
****Firerate changed from 2 to {{Tooltip|0.75 > 0.5|-0.25}}.
****Range increased from +0 to +2.
****Max targets increase of +1 added.
****Added damage increase of +2 added.
****Name changed fro ''Head Chopping'' to ''The Judge & The Jury''.

===Miscellaneous===
*Fixed existing [[Hacker]] skins breaking their animations upon [[Revive|reviving]] in a match.
*Fixed [[Pulse Trooper]] not contributing DPS counter.
*Fixed [[Pulse Trooper]] lacking lead detection at Level 2.
